text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the fitted shape minus that of am in each lead band. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole weeks of forecast start and seeds. Line at 0: same score as am. All rows are exploratory. In the 10+ day band the weight of the solar term is zero. Five Primary substations, daylight half-hours of April to September, forecast runs one every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026. Quantile score in points of capacity (1 point is 1% of a substation's capacity).'
